economicPremise: Causal, sufficiently broad equity-index risk impulse may transmit with a delay into cross-asset FX/gold and non-source index prices. A separate relative-underreaction rule requires the target's preceding one-hour movement to oppose the predeclared index-implied side. Both are falsifiable across all targets.
phaseCalendar: 26/13/13 complete predeclared weeks; last thirteen globally exposed audit, never independent; all clock failures count as evidence gaps
signalPolicy: At each completed M5 End clock, require at least two index prior-hour changes of same sign and abs>=5bps, all known at decision time. Take that sign times fixed target response. Underreaction additionally requires prior target 60m return >=5bps opposite implied side. No outcome-based sign fitting, no threshold search, no return-based subset exclusion.
costs: Separate conditional central/adverse/stress spreads from development true BID/ASK quote contexts and maximum currently observed tariff commission. Central: mean spread + max commission + two sides (0.25 mean spread + one second diffusion proxy). Adverse: p90 spread + 1.25 max commission + two sides (0.5 p90 spread + 2 times one-second vol). Stress: 2 p90 spread + 2 max commission + two sides (p90 spread + 3 times one-second vol). No historical ASK/fills or historical funding asserted; avoid crossing UTC date. Accounts denominated EUR not derivable from standalone bps.
missing: No complete index/target hour history, exact forward completion, current cost context or funding support: unknown or abstain; never zero-fill or optimize missing outcomes.
multipleTests: All 9 targets x 2 families x 2 horizons x 3 cost cases, plus every weekly observation: 36 predeclared groups, no after-the-fact winner, overlap not independent.
followup: Selection-only >=30 complete episodes in >=8 active weeks and adverse weekly mean lower proxy >0 may justify a NEW independently registered native EUR200 incremental funded portfolio study, not qualification; audit may never choose a winner.
allocator: No separate account per group; joint clock opportunity/funding coverage only; no summed proxy bps to EUR200, no funded NET or HARD21 claim; native orchestrator remains sole eventual selector
